description: Free sample. Before installing an MCP server, skill or tool: is its description poisoned (hidden orders to the agent, excessive permissions, look-alike names)? Returns allow, review or block with reasons.

description.description: The description text it exposes to the agent.

name.description: Name of the tool or server.

permissions.description: Optional permissions requested, for example filesystem:write, network, shell.

tools.description: Optional list of { name, description } of the functions it exposes.
